criteria.1.1: WHEN the Operator registers a Discount_Code with a valid Code_String, Discount_Kind, Discount_Value, Minimum_Subtotal, and Expiry_Date, THE Code_Registry SHALL store it under its upper-case Code_String.
criteria.1.2: IF the Discount_Kind is `percent` and the Discount_Value is outside 1–50, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the Discount_Code with a ValueError.
criteria.1.3: IF the Discount_Kind is `fixed` and the Discount_Value is outside 1–10,000,000, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the Discount_Code with a ValueError.
criteria.1.4: IF the Code_String, Discount_Kind, Discount_Value, Minimum_Subtotal, or Expiry_Date does not match its Glossary format, THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the Discount_Code with a ValueError.
criteria.1.5: IF the Operator registers a Code_String that the Code_Registry already holds (any letter case), THEN THE Code_Registry SHALL reject the Discount_Code with a ValueError.
criteria.2.1: WHEN the Shopper sends `POST /carts/<id>/discount` with a body `code` and no error in criteria 2.2 to 2.7 applies, THE Shop_API SHALL attach the code to the Cart and return status 200 with `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.2.2: IF the body `code` is missing or does not match the Code_String format, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 400 with error `bad code` and leave the Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.3: IF the body `code` matches no Discount_Code in the Code_Registry, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 404 with error `unknown code` and leave the Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.4: IF Today is after the Expiry_Date of the named Discount_Code, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 422 with error `code expired` and leave the Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.5: IF the Subtotal is below the Minimum_Subtotal of the named Discount_Code, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 422 with error `minimum not met` and leave the Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.6: IF the Cart already holds a Discount_Code, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 409 with error `code already applied` and leave the Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.7: IF the cart id names no Cart, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 404 with error `no cart`.
criteria.2.8: THE Shop_API SHALL check conditions in this order and return the first error: no cart, bad code, unknown code, code already applied, code expired, minimum not met.
criteria.2.9: IF `ctx["today"]` is missing or is not a `YYYY-MM-DD` date, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL raise a ValueError before any other check, for every request that reads a Cart, and leave every Cart unchanged.
criteria.2.10: THE Shop_API SHALL treat a body `code` as well-formed only when it is a string of 1–20 characters from `A–Z`, `a–z`, `0–9`, `-`.
criteria.3.1: WHILE the Cart holds a `percent` Discount_Code whose Minimum_Subtotal is met and whose Expiry_Date is not before Today, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to floor(Subtotal × Discount_Value ÷ 100) cents.
criteria.3.2: WHILE the Cart holds a `fixed` Discount_Code whose Minimum_Subtotal is met and whose Expiry_Date is not before Today, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to the smaller of Discount_Value and Subtotal, in cents.
criteria.3.3: WHILE the Cart holds no Discount_Code, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0 cents.
criteria.3.4: THE Cart SHALL set Total to the larger of 0 and Subtotal minus Discount_Amount, in cents.
criteria.3.5: WHILE the Cart holds a Discount_Code and the Subtotal is below its Minimum_Subtotal, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0 cents.
criteria.3.6: WHILE the Cart holds a Discount_Code and Today is after its Expiry_Date, THE Cart SHALL set Discount_Amount to 0 cents.
criteria.4.1: WHEN the Shopper sends `GET /carts/<id>`, THE Shop_API SHALL return `lines`, `subtotal_cents`, `discount_code` (upper-case Code_String or null), `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.4.2: WHEN the Shopper sends `POST /carts/<id>/lines` and the line is added, THE Shop_API SHALL return status 200 with `subtotal_cents`, `discount_cents`, and `total_cents`.
criteria.4.3: WHEN the Shopper sends `DELETE /carts/<id>/discount` and the Cart holds a Discount_Code, THE Shop_API SHALL detach the code and return status 200 with `discount_cents` equal to 0.
criteria.4.4: IF the Shopper sends `DELETE /carts/<id>/discount` and the Cart holds no Discount_Code, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 404 with error `no code applied`.
criteria.4.5: IF the body of `POST /carts/<id>/lines` lacks an integer `unit_price_cents` of 0–10,000,000 or an integer `quantity` of 1–1,000, THEN THE Shop_API SHALL return status 400 with error `bad line` and leave the Cart unchanged.
